## Claims

- Aarhus University Hospital stated that before data capture is optimized, indicator 1 does not provide an accurate picture of diagnostic quality at the hospital [^src1] ([[aarhus-university-hospital|Aarhus University Hospital]])
- Regionshospitalet Gødstrup considers re-operation rate a poor quality measure, arguing that anastomotic leak is a better indicator as used in cancer surgery [^src1] ([[goedstrup-hospital|Gødstrup Hospital]])

## Sources

[^src1]: DANIBD_2024.pdf, pages 46-47
